inputs.statement_a: Norvale Motors sold 4.27 million vehicles in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Norvale Motors reported revenue of $4.27 million in 2024.

rationale: Same figure, but a count of vehicles is not an amount of money; the measures differ.

inputs.statement_a: Aldine Capital, the London asset manager, closed a $400 million fund in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Aldine Capital, the Houston energy lender, closed a $400 million fund in 2024.

rationale: Two different companies share a name; the descriptors identify different entities. Both facts can be true.

inputs.statement_a: Helix Foods supplies Brightmart with frozen meals.
inputs.statement_b: Helix Foods competes with Brightmart in frozen meals.

rationale: Same two companies, different relationship. Both can be true; neither implies the other.

inputs.statement_a: Kestrel Air operates 120 aircraft.
inputs.statement_b: Kestrel Air has 120 aircraft on order.

rationale: The same number counts different things (fleet in service versus orders); both can be true.

inputs.statement_a: Orrin Bio's drug OB-12 entered a Phase 2 trial in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Orrin Bio's drug OB-21 entered a Phase 2 trial in 2024.

rationale: Two different drugs of one company; a one-character identifier difference is a different subject.

inputs.statement_a: Brightmart opened 40 new stores in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Brightmart closed 40 stores in 2024.

rationale: Opposite store movements with the same count; both can be true, so they are different facts, not a contradiction.

inputs.statement_a: Helix Foods' revenue was $2.1 billion in fiscal 2023.
inputs.statement_b: Helix Foods' revenue was $2.1 billion in fiscal 2024.

rationale: Same value in two consecutive years: two observations, both true. The period is part of the fact.

inputs.statement_a: Kestrel Air's cargo division had a net margin of 6.2% in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Kestrel Air had a group net margin of 6.2% in 2024.

rationale: Same figure for a division and for the whole group: different scopes, so different facts.

inputs.statement_a: Brightmart's revenue was $900 million in the fourth quarter of 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Brightmart's revenue was $900 million in the full year 2024.

rationale: A quarter and a full year with the same figure: different periods, so different facts.

inputs.statement_a: Orrin Bio had 310 employees at the end of 2022.
inputs.statement_b: Orrin Bio had 310 employees at the end of 2024.

rationale: Headcount at two dates; it happens to be unchanged, but these are two observations.

inputs.statement_a: Norvale Motors Inc. named Priya Nair chief financial officer in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Norvale appointed Priya Nair as CFO in 2024.

structured_a.value: Priya Nair as chief financial officer

rationale: Legal-name versus short-name alias, and 'named' versus 'appointed', 'chief financial officer' versus 'CFO'.

inputs.statement_a: Helix Foods acquired Brightmart in 2023 for $1.2 billion.
inputs.statement_b: Brightmart was bought by Helix Foods in 2023 for $1.2 billion.

rationale: Active versus passive voice; the acquirer, target, price and year are the same.

inputs.statement_a: Kestrel Air Holdings reported 2024 revenue of $5.0 billion.
inputs.statement_b: KST posted 2024 sales of $5.0 billion.
inputs.passage_b: Kestrel Air Holdings (NYSE: KST) ended the year with record results. KST posted 2024 sales of $5.0 billion.

rationale: KST is Kestrel Air Holdings' ticker, stated in the second Passage; 'revenue' and 'sales' are synonyms.

inputs.statement_a: Orrin Biotherapeutics is headquartered in Leiden.
inputs.statement_b: Orrin Bio is based in Leiden.

rationale: Full and short company name; 'headquartered in' and 'based in' state the same location.

inputs.statement_a: Tessera Energy's 2024 revenue was $4.27 billion.
inputs.statement_b: Tessera Energy's revenue came to about $4.3 billion in 2024.

rationale: A rounded figure and its exact value state the same fact; $4.3 billion is $4.27 billion to two figures.

inputs.statement_a: Orrin Bio employs about 310 people.
inputs.statement_b: Orrin Bio's headcount is approximately 310.

rationale: Two hedges ('about', 'approximately') on the same number, and 'employs people' versus 'headcount'.

inputs.statement_a: Helix Foods' operating margin was 8.4% in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Helix Foods earned an operating margin of 8.4% in 2024, up from 7.9% a year earlier.

rationale: The second statement adds the prior-year comparison; the 2024 fact is the same.

inputs.statement_a: Tessera Energy had 4.27 million active users in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Tessera Energy had 4.27 billion active users in 2024.

rationale: Same measure, entity and period with values a thousand times apart; both cannot be right.

inputs.statement_a: Helix Foods was profitable in fiscal 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Helix Foods reported a net loss in fiscal 2024.

rationale: Profitable and a net loss for the same year are mutually exclusive.

inputs.statement_a: Mara Quill is the chief executive of Orrin Bio as of March 2025.
inputs.statement_b: Jonas Pike is the chief executive of Orrin Bio as of March 2025.

rationale: A single-valued role held by two different people on the same date.

inputs.statement_a: Kestrel Air's passenger traffic rose 8% in 2024.
inputs.statement_b: Kestrel Air's passenger traffic fell 8% in 2024.

rationale: Opposite directions of the same change over the same year.

inputs.statement_a: Brightmart's revenue was $900 million last quarter.
inputs.statement_b: Brightmart's revenue was $900 million in the fourth quarter of 2024.
inputs.passage_a: Published 15 January 2025. Brightmart's revenue was $900 million last quarter.
inputs.passage_b: Brightmart reported fourth-quarter 2024 revenue of $900 million.

rationale: The first Passage is dated 15 January 2025, so 'last quarter' is Q4 2024.

inputs.statement_a: Orrin Bio has 310 employees.
inputs.statement_b: Orrin Bio has 310 employees.
inputs.passage_a: Published 3 May 2021. Orrin Bio has 310 employees and plans to expand.
inputs.passage_b: Published 9 June 2025. Orrin Bio has 310 employees after a round of layoffs.

rationale: Identical present-tense wording, but the Passages are published years apart, so the as-of dates differ.

inputs.statement_a: Kestrel Air will carry 35 million passengers this year.
inputs.statement_b: Kestrel Air will carry 35 million passengers this year.
inputs.passage_a: Published 12 February 2023. Kestrel Air will carry 35 million passengers this year.
inputs.passage_b: Published 20 February 2024. Kestrel Air will carry 35 million passengers this year.

rationale: 'This year' is 2023 in one Passage and 2024 in the other; two projections for different years.

inputs.passage: Helix Foods, founded in 1987, is headquartered in Leeds and sells frozen meals in 14 countries.

rationale: A genuine quotation about the right company that says nothing about 2024 revenue.

inputs.statement: Orrin Bio's OB-12 trial met its primary endpoint.
inputs.passage: Orrin Bio will present OB-12 trial results at the March conference.

rationale: Announcing that results will be presented does not say what they were.

inputs.statement: Kestrel Air carried 31 million passengers in 2024.
inputs.passage: Kestrel Air operates 120 aircraft, and its fleet has an average age of nine years.

rationale: Fleet size and age are related to traffic but do not state a passenger count.

inputs.passage: Tessera Energy expects 2024 revenue of about $4.27 billion, according to guidance issued in January 2024.

rationale: Guidance is a forecast; it does not establish what revenue turned out to be.
What happened last year does not support a statement about next year's plan.

inputs.statement: Helix Foods' 2024 net income was $210 million.
inputs.passage: Helix Foods forecasts 2024 net income of between $190 million and $210 million.

rationale: The upper end of a forecast range is not a reported result.
Near-identical wording with transposed digits: high similarity, wrong number.

inputs.statement: Tessera Energy's revenue was exactly $4.27 billion in 2024.
inputs.passage: Tessera Energy's revenue was about $4.3 billion in 2024.

rationale: The Passage is rounded; it cannot establish the exact figure the statement claims.

inputs.statement: Helix Foods' operating margin was 12% in 2024.
inputs.passage: Helix Foods' gross margin was 12% in 2024; its operating margin was 7%.

rationale: The number 12% is present but belongs to gross margin; the Passage gives operating margin as 7%.
Right entity, measure and number but a different year; the Passage says nothing about 2024.

inputs.statement: Kestrel Air carried 31 million passengers in 2024.
inputs.passage: Kestrel Air said it carried 31 million passengers in 2024, up 6% on the year before.

rationale: The Passage states the figure for the year directly.

inputs.statement: Orrin Bio named Jonas Pike as chief executive.
inputs.passage: Orrin Bio on Tuesday appointed Jonas Pike as its CEO, replacing Mara Quill.

rationale: A paraphrase ('named'/'appointed', 'chief executive'/'CEO') of an explicit statement.

inputs.claim: Helix Foods cut prices by 10% to win market share.
inputs.passage_text: Helix Foods said it expects prices to rise 10% next year as input costs climb.

rationale: The span is real and contains 10%, but it says prices will rise, not that they were cut.

inputs.passage_text: Brightmart's store count reached a record 1,200 at the end of the year.

rationale: The span is real; 'a record' means the count rose, so 'fell' misreads it.

inputs.claim: Norvale Motors delivered 410,000 vehicles in the third quarter.
inputs.passage_text: Tessera Motors delivered 410,000 vehicles in the third quarter, ahead of rival Norvale Motors.
inputs.quoted_span: Tessera Motors delivered 410,000 vehicles in the third quarter

rationale: Both names appear, but the 410,000 deliveries belong to Tessera Motors, not Norvale.

inputs.claim: Orrin Bio's R&D spend was $90 million.
inputs.passage_text: Orrin Bio's revenue was $90 million; its R&D spend was $40 million.

rationale: The figure $90 million is in the Passage but it is revenue; R&D spend is $40 million.

inputs.claim: Kestrel Air's cargo division had a net margin of 6.2% in 2024.

rationale: The span alone is bare, but the table caption names the division and year, which the Claim states.

inputs.claim: Tessera Energy's battery output reached 4.27 gigawatt-hours.
inputs.passage_text: Battery output hit 4.27 GWh at Tessera Energy's Nevada plant.

rationale: GWh is the abbreviation of gigawatt-hours; the figure and entity match.

inputs.claim: Helix Foods reported fiscal 2024 revenue of $2.4 billion, about 3% higher than the year before.
inputs.passage_text: Helix Foods' fiscal 2024 revenue came to US$2.4bn, roughly 3% above the prior year.
inputs.quoted_span: fiscal 2024 revenue came to US$2.4bn, roughly 3% above the prior year

rationale: 'US$2.4bn' is $2.4 billion and 'roughly 3% above' is 'about 3% higher'.

inputs.passage_text: Brightmart opened 25 stores in 2024 and closed six.

rationale: The quoted span does not occur in the Passage, and the Passage gives 25, not 40.

inputs.source_a_text: By staff reporter. Helix Foods said profit rose 14% in fiscal 2024 on strong frozen-meal demand.
inputs.source_b_text: Helix Foods said profit rose 14% in fiscal 2024 on strong frozen-meal demand. Originally published by The Daily Ledger: https://www.dailyledger.example/news/helix-profit

rationale: The second article is a republication and links back to the first.

inputs.source_a_text: (Wire News) - Kestrel Air said on Monday it carried 31 million passengers in 2024, up 6%. Reporting by A. Reporter; editing by B. Editor.
inputs.source_b_text: Kestrel Air said on Monday it carried 31 million passengers in 2024, up 6%. Reporting by A. Reporter; editing by B. Editor. (Wire News)

rationale: Verbatim wire copy on another domain with no link, but the wire credit and byline show it is one report.

inputs.source_a_text: Our analysis of Kestrel Air's annual filing shows 31 million passengers in 2024. Fuel hedging, not traffic, drove the margin gain, said analyst D. Okoro.
inputs.source_b_text: At Kestrel Air's home hub we counted queues, spoke to staff and reviewed the airport authority's figures: about 31 million passengers passed through in 2024.

rationale: Different outlets, each with its own sourcing (a filing and an airport authority), no shared text or links.

inputs.source_a_text: Helix Foods completed its $1.2 billion purchase of Brightmart in 2023, two people familiar with the matter said.
inputs.source_b_text: Brightmart's store managers were told in 2023 that Helix Foods had closed its $1.2 billion acquisition, according to an internal memo seen by Grocery Weekly.

rationale: Separate sourcing (insiders versus an internal memo) and different wording; neither cites the other.
